name: Shadow Shogun
summary: The supreme coven of Asia — a shadow government that rules from behind the throne. Their network spans the entire continent.
lore: The Shadow Shogun does not merely rule — the Shadow Shogun is rule itself. Every war, every alliance, every betrayal in Asia for five hundred years has flowed through Edo Castle. To challenge them is to challenge the structure of power itself.

events.title: The Shadow Walk
events.narrative: A shinobi infiltrates your dojo at midnight, leaving a single shuriken embedded in your pillow. It is a message.

choiceA.label: Track the shinobi and confront them

random.winMessage: You catch the shinobi and earn their respect. Two of their clan join you. +4 Followers.
random.lossMessage: The shinobi vanishes into shadow. Three followers lose faith. -3 Followers.

choiceB.label: Send a counter-message via your own agent

events.title: A Ronin Demands a Duel
events.narrative: A masterless samurai stands at your gate, hand on his blade. He says your coven dishonors the old ways.

choiceA.label: Accept the duel
choiceA.description: +30% Faith if you win, -5 Followers if you lose

random.winMessage: Your blade-spirit is stronger. The ronin yields and joins your coven. +30% Faith.
random.lossMessage: The ronin's technique is flawless. Five followers lose heart. -5 Followers.

choiceB.label: Offer him rice and a place to rest

events.title: A Zen Master Visits
events.narrative: An old monk arrives, asking to meditate in your garden. He says your coven chases power but misses truth.

choiceA.label: Meditate with him for three days

events.title: A Hidden Village Revealed
events.narrative: Your scouts discover a ninja village hidden in the mountain mist. They have been watching you for weeks.

random.winMessage: They submit rather than face your wrath. Their tribute is generous. +22% Gold.
random.lossMessage: They vanish into the night, and four followers follow them. -4 Followers.

events.title: The Cursed Katana
events.narrative: A traveling merchant offers a katana that hums with trapped spirits. He says it cuts through more than flesh.

events.title: The Tea Ceremony
events.narrative: A rival daimyo invites you to a tea ceremony. It is a trap — or a test. The line is razor-thin.

choiceB.label: Send a proxy and stay safe

events.title: The Ghost Army
events.narrative: On a foggy night, you hear the stamp of ten thousand phantom feet. The spirits of fallen samurai march past your walls.

choiceA.label: Join their march and absorb their spirit

choiceB.label: Ward your compound and let them pass

events.title: The Poison Garden
events.narrative: A monk offers seeds from a garden where every plant kills. He says the right poison is a medicine.

choiceA.label: Plant the garden and learn the arts

events.title: The Emperor's Summons
events.narrative: A messenger in imperial livery arrives with a sealed scroll. The Emperor requests your presence at court.

random.winMessage: Your defiance inspires the people. +20% Faith.
random.lossMessage: The Emperor's displeasure spreads doubt. -3 Followers.

events.title: The Cherry Blossom Rite
events.narrative: The cherry trees bloom across your territory. It is the season of renewal — and of dark rites performed beneath the petals.
